name: Set Timer Resolution
description: Adjusts the system timer resolution to improve input responsiveness and frame pacing in latency-sensitive applications.

description_i18n.en: Adjusts the system timer resolution to improve input responsiveness and frame pacing in latency-sensitive applications.
description_i18n.de: Passt die System-Timerauflösung an, um Eingabeantwortzeit und Bildrhythmus bei latenzempfindlichen Anwendungen zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Ajuste la résolution du minuteur système pour améliorer la réactivité de l'entrée et le rythme des images dans les applications sensibles à la latence.

warnings.title: Increased Power Usage
warnings.message: Reducing the timer resolution increases CPU wake frequency under load, which may increase power draw and heat output on laptops or battery-powered devices

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary data may be removed. Windows or apps may take a moment to rebuild it

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Uses native Windows APIs to set a finer timer interval, typically reducing the default value from 15ms down to approximately 0.5-1ms
compact_description: Optimizes timer resolution for lower input latency and better responsiveness.
